title_en: COP31 climate talks deadlock on day 13

context_en: Quake strikes near Junin at 00:09 UTC, felt as far as Lima; no deaths reported.

title_en: Russian barrage kills two in Kryvyi Rih

title_en: Two tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz

context_en: Sanctioned freighter Sparta II burns in Gulf of Finland; 16 crew evacuated to Finland.
title_en: Russian cargo ship hit by drones

context_en: Antonelli fastest in qualifying but a grid penalty hands pole to Verstappen; Russell second.
K-pop giants win Album and Artist of the Year in Osaka; rookie CORTIS takes Song of the Year.
CRS-35 returns 6,300 lbs of ISS science to the Pacific off California with a sonic boom.
Strike kills three World Central Kitchen workers in Gaza City; four dead in Gaza on Saturday.

title_en: Air Niugini jet lands safely in Davao

context_en: England record their biggest ever winning margin over the All Blacks at Twickenham.

title_en: Basra power plant fire kills four

context_en: Ex-president, jailed for 27 years, admitted to ICU in Brasilia with acute intestinal obstruction.
128 nations agree to negotiate rules on lethal autonomous weapons within two years, without binding pledge.
title_en: UN agrees talks on killer robots

context_en: Endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh swims the strait to spotlight the Iran war's toll on wildlife.
Cartel leader Fausto Isidro Meza Flores and two others captured in Sinaloa on Friday night.
Premier Li Qiang and PM Lawrence Wong meet in Beijing; over 20 deals due at bilateral council.
title_en: China, Singapore speed up FTA talks

Guinea's mining crackdown drives 70,126 returnees home; 38 Ghanaians still await repatriation.
